caseNameFull: UNITED STATES v. Joseph A. FAUSTO

opinions.text: The motion of respondent to amend the question presented is denied. The motion of respondent to file a brief pro se is granted. The motion of respondent to present oral argument pro se is denied. John M. Nannes, Esquire, of Washington, D.C., a member of the Bar of this Court, is invited to brief and argue this case, as amicus curiae, in support of the judgment below.
